steps.title: 1. Emergency utility disconnect delay (immediate)
steps.description: Call the utility at the number on this step with account {{accountNumber}}. Request a 14-day extension on the {{pastDue}} past-due balance pending solar installation.

steps.title: 2. Sunrun Brightbox agreement and proposal (Option B ownership)
steps.description: Horace Lawrence sends the proposal package and DocuSign agreement for 14.76 kW + Tesla Powerwall 3 ($198/mo fixed loan, $0 down) via srep=/powergenie.

steps.title: 3. Site assessment and 200A busbar check
steps.description: Sunrun technician 3D drone roof mapping and electrical service panel inspection at {{address}}.

steps.title: 4. CAD plan set and county permitting
steps.description: Engineering stamps, wind and structural load calculations, and 36-inch fire ridge setback drawings submitted for permit.

steps.title: 5. Utility interconnection application
steps.description: Submit the single-line diagram to the utility portal. Specify an exterior, lockable, utility-accessible manual AC disconnect switch.

steps.title: 6. Professional installation (1-day build)
steps.description: Mount 36 tier-1 monocrystalline panels, Tesla Powerwall 3 (13.5 kWh LFP), and Tesla Backup Gateway 2.

steps.title: 7. Final inspection and meter swap (PTO)
steps.description: Final electrical sign-off, then the utility installs a bi-directional net generation meter. System energized for 96.5% bill offset.
